title: Componentwise completed internal-Hom evaluation
statement: Let X,I,F,G,e,he,U satisfy the following assumptions: X is Noetherian, I is quasi-coherent, F,G coherent, and e_n:H/I^(n+1)H→Hom(G/I^(n+1)G,F/I^(n+1)F) satisfies qH_n ≫ e_n ≫ precomposition(qG_n) = postcomposition(qF_n), where qH_n,qG_n,qF_n are the sheaf quotient projections, where H=Hom(G,F). Let U be an affine open [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Put A=O_X(U), J=I(U), B=completed A, N=G(U), M=F(U). Given A-linear projections pN_n and pM_n from completed N and M to the sheaf quotient sections, agreeing with ordinary quotients on of and satisfying the completed scalar representative rule of [lem-weil-pbc-completion-affine-sections-coordinates], there are an equivalence rho from compatible H quotient sections to completed Hom_A(N,M), and a B-linear map E from that completion to Hom_B(completed N,completed M). E(of(h))=completed h. At each n and each completed x, evaluating e_n(s_n) on pN_n(x) is pM_n(E(rho(s))(x)). Evaluation of local Hom sections at U is injective at each level. No compatible t, supplied epsilon, or equality criterion is asserted.

proof.text: Internal Hom is coherent. Use the existing coherence criterion to install quasi-coherence and finite type for G,F and Hom(G,F). Apply the existing Scheme.Modules.finite_sections_of_finiteType directly to N,M,Hs=Hom(G,F)(U), without restating a coherent finite-section theorem. Apply the affine Hom-section evaluation bijection K:Hs≃Hom_A(N,M) and the quotient-coordinate lemma. Its jointly injective and universal projections give an equivalence from compatible sections to completed Hs. Compose with AdicCompletion.congr K to get rho.

The affine section ring is Noetherian. Construct E using the finite-module tensor/completion equivalences for Hom_A(N,M), N and M, tensor extension of ordinary linear maps and arrow conjugation. The completion naturality identity shows that E(of(h)) is AdicCompletion.map J h.

Evaluate he at U on an ordinary Hom section and an ordinary G section. By the definitions of homObjMap and homObjEvalId, this is precisely the ordinary quotient evaluation formula. Tensor induction on completed N, using scalar representatives and the generator formula, extends this equality to all completed inputs. Tensor induction on completed Hs extends it to all compatible H sections, giving the displayed component formula.

formalCompletionSystem_coherent makes each quotient of G coherent. The locally Noetherian coherence criterion makes it quasi-coherent, and the affine Hom-section evaluation bijection gives injectivity at each level.
